incidents.summary: Johnson Matthey Inc admitted a Clean Water Act violation involving selective wastewater sampling and was fined $2.25 million, subsequently contributing $750,000 and entering a compliance agreement.

sources.title: Johnson Matthey
sources.quote: In December 2008 US subsidiary Johnson Matthey Inc was fined $2.25 million for a felony violation of the United States Clean Water Act, after admitting to violating the act at its Salt Lake City precious metals refining facility.

sources.title: Johnson Matthey
sources.quote: The violation related to the selective screening of wastewater samples for compliance analysis.

sources.title: Johnson Matthey
sources.quote: Following the charge Johnson Matthey Inc contributed $750,000 to the National Fish and Wildlife Foundation and entered a three-year compliance agreement with the US Environmental Protection Agency.

incidents.summary: Following its Sevierville plant explosion, Johnson Matthey received eight state safety citations and a $13,100 fine, with the company appealing the findings.

sources.title: Documents reveal details of Johnson Matthey Sevierville plant explosion
sources.quote: Johnson Matthey is now facing eight violations from the state, seven of which are categorized as “serious.” The two main catalysts of the explosion were a faulty roof and dust collection system, according to the documents.

sources.title: Johnson Matthey contesting state findings on explosion | News | themountainpress.com
Documents reveal details of Johnson Matthey Sevierville plant explosion
sources.quote: Johnson Matthey representatives said they have appealed it as well.

incidents.summary: The dispute over Johnson Matthey’s former health-business sale remained headed for trial in July 2025, including an allegation that a statement in a draft disclosure letter constituted misrepresentation.

sources.title: Chemicals giant Johnson Matthey embroiled in bitter legal battle against US buyer of its former health business
sources.quote: A High Court scrap is developing over the sale to New York investment fund Altaris Capital Partners for £325 million.

sources.title: Court entertains argument that statements in draft disclosure letter amounted to misrepresentations (Veranova Bidco LP v Johnson Matthey plc) | News | LexisNexis
sources.quote: The High Court has entertained the argument that an allegedly false statement contained in a draft disclosure letter produced during the course of transaction negotiations may have amounted to a misrepresentation.

sources.title: Court entertains argument that statements in draft disclosure letter amounted to misrepresentations (Veranova Bidco LP v Johnson Matthey plc) | News | LexisNexis
sources.quote: The case will proceed to a full trial.

incidents.summary: Johnson Matthey disclosed a third-party breach involving over 6,000 employee records, with documents potentially stored without access controls since 2020, and offered two years of identity protection.

sources.title: Johnson Matthey suffers a third-party breach | Cybernews
sources.quote: Sustainable technology company Johnson Matthey has suffered a third-party data breach, revealing over 6000 employee records.

sources.title: Johnson Matthey suffers a third-party breach | Cybernews
sources.quote: While our investigation is ongoing, the company believes the documents may have been stored on the platform since 2020 without access controls,

sources.title: Johnson Matthey suffers a third-party breach | Cybernews
sources.quote: Johnson Matthey is offering two years of identity protection as compensation for the incident.
